archetype: A class archetype represents a subclass or specialization that defines your character's unique abilities and playstyle.
Arcane Tradition: Each school of magic represents a different approach to arcane study. Choose one that matches your wizard's specialty.
Divine Domain: Your deity grants you powers based on their domain. Each domain represents different aspects of divine power.
Druid Circle: Druids belong to circles that represent different relationships with nature. Each circle provides unique benefits.
Fighting Style: Your training with weapons defines how you fight. Choose a style that matches your combat approach.
Martial Archetype: Fighters develop specific martial archetypes that define their combat philosophy. Each provides unique features.
Metamagic: As you advance, you learn metamagic techniques that modify how you cast spells. These choices define your sorcery.
Monastic Tradition: Monks follow different traditions that represent their training disciplines. Each provides unique ki abilities.
Otherworldly Patron: Your patron defines the nature of your warlock pact. Different patrons grant different powers.
Pact Boon: Your pact with your patron grants you a specific benefit. Each boons provides unique capabilities.
Primal Path: Barbarians follow different primal paths that embody their rage. Each path represents a different approach to battle fury.
Ranger Archetype: Rangers develop specific archetypes that define their approach to hunting. Each provides unique wilderness abilities.
Roguish Archetype: Rogues specialize in different roguish archetypes that define their style. Each provides unique stealth and trickery.
Sacred Oath: Paladins swear sacred oaths that define their dedication. Each oath grants unique holy powers.
Sorcerous Origin: Your sorcerous origin defines where your innate power comes from. Each origin provides unique magical abilities.
